brief:
US Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries, who is expected to become the first Black speaker of the House of Representatives next year, has pledged to advance legislation targeting settler violence, Middle East Eye reported. Jeffries, described as pro-Israel, made the commitment as part of efforts to address Palestinian concerns while maintaining support for Israel.

The pledge comes as Israeli settler attacks on Palestinians have intensified in the occupied West Bank, drawing international scrutiny and calls for accountability.

title: Jeffries pledges legislation against Israeli settler violence
